class TTLCache:
    def __init__(self, capacity: int, ttl: float, clock: Callable[[], float]):
        if capacity < 1:
            raise ValueError("capacity must be >= 1")
        if ttl < 0:
            raise ValueError("ttl must be non-negative")
        self._capacity = capacity
        self._ttl = float(ttl)
        self._clock = clock
        # OrderedDict maps key -> (value, expire_time)
        # Order: least-recently-used at beginning, most-recently-used at end
        self._data = OrderedDict()

    def _purge_expired(self):
        now = self._clock()
        # Iterate from least-recently-used to most; remove any expired entries.
        # Can't stop at first unexpired because later ones may also be expired if
        # entries were reinserted; so collect all expired keys.
        keys_to_remove = [k for k, (_, exp) in self._data.items() if now >= exp]
        for k in keys_to_remove:
            self._data.pop(k, None)

        now = self._clock()
        exp = now + self._ttl
        if key in self._data:
            # update value and expiry, mark as most-recently-used
            self._data.pop(key)
            self._data[key] = (value, exp)
        else:

                # evict least-recently-used (first item)
                self._data.popitem(last=False)
            self._data[key] = (value, exp)

            return None

        self._data.pop(key)
        self._data[key] = (value, now + self._ttl)
        return value

_slug_re = re.compile(r'[^a-z0-9]+')

def slugify(s: str, max_len: Optional[int] = None) -> str:
    if max_len is not None and max_len < 1:
        raise ValueError("max_len must be >= 1")
    if s is None:
        s = ""
    # Transliterate: NFKD then keep only ASCII
    normalized = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", s)
    ascii_only = normalized.encode("ascii", "ignore").decode("ascii")
    lower = ascii_only.lower()
    # Replace runs of non a-z0-9 with single hyphen
    slug = _slug_re.sub('-', lower).strip('-')
    if max_len is not None and len(slug) > max_len:
        # find last hyphen at or before max_len
        cut_pos = slug.rfind('-', 0, max_len + 1)
        if cut_pos == -1:
            # no hyphen found - hard cut first word
            slug = slug[:max_len]
        else:
            slug = slug[:cut_pos]
        slug = slug.strip('-')
    if not slug:
        return "n-a"
    return slug
